title: Fix Demonstrator Introduction Steps On Wrong App
description: In the mit-bestand demonstrator 2x3 multi-shell grid, introduction UI always appears on the top-right app (Aggregator) while non-top-right apps can still advance introduction steps. Root causes: (1) UIIntroduction/demonstration overlays use position:fixed with viewport coordinates while the demonstrator pans via CSS transform, so fixed containing-block math places overlays wrong across shells; (2) suppressAutoIntroduction only blocks auto-start and does not dismiss an already-running introduction when a pane loses focus, leaving stale overlays and global hotkeys from background shells; (3) introduction Next/Back/Skip keybindings use ungated useHotkeys so every mounted intro advances together.
summary:
Fixed demonstrator introduction steps appearing on the wrong (top-right) app.

## Root causes
1. UIIntroduction / demonstration overlays used position:fixed with viewport coordinates while the demonstrator pans via CSS transform — fixed containing-block math placed overlays across the wrong shell.
2. suppressAutoIntroduction only blocked auto-start and did not dismiss an already-running tour when a pane lost focus, leaving stale veils/hotkeys from background shells.
3. Introduction Next/Back/Skip used ungated useHotkeys, so every mounted intro advanced together.

## Fix
- Dismiss introduction when suppressAutoIntroduction becomes true (ShellHost).
- Shell portal layer is absolute inset-0 under a position:relative .semio-scope; UIIntroduction portals into it.
- Overlays use absolute + host-local coords inside a shell (fixed + viewport coords outside any ShellScope for the landing tour).
- Gate introduction hotkeys with useIsActiveShellRoot.
- Stamp data-introduction-active on the shell root (not always documentElement).

## Verification
- bun nx run @semio-tech/ui-react:test -t UIIntroduction → 41 passed.
- New unit tests for introductionRectRelativeToHost / introductionPointRelativeToHost.
